zh.title: 受暴雨影響 台鐵南迴線與台東線週一上午對號列車停駛
zh.summary: 受暴雨影響，台鐵南迴線及台東線對號列車於週一上午採取停駛措施。
body: 受強烈暴雨襲擊台灣南部及東部地區影響，台灣鐵路公司宣布調整列車營運規劃。台鐵南迴線與台東線之對號列車，於週一上午全面採取停駛措施。
此次營運調整主要受到南部與東部地區暴雨天氣影響，台鐵針對南迴線及台東線對號列車實施停駛規劃。搭乘該區段對號列車之旅客需留意相關列車營運動態與服務調整。
台鐵南迴線連接台灣南部與東部，台東線則貫穿東部地區。面對暴雨威脅，台鐵於週一上午暫停上述兩線對號列車行駛，以維護整體鐵路運輸安全。

en.title: TRA Suspends South-Link and Taitung Line Reserved Trains Due to Heavy Rain
en.summary: Taiwan Railways suspends South-Link and Taitung Line express trains on Monday morning amid heavy rainfall.
body: Heavy rainfall has slammed southern and eastern Taiwan, leading to service suspensions on key rail corridors. Taiwan Railways Administration announced that reserved express trains on the South-Link Line and the Taitung Line will be suspended on Monday morning.

The service adjustments affect reserved passenger train operations across both the South-Link Line and the Taitung Line. Passengers traveling through southern and eastern Taiwan are advised to monitor official updates regarding train schedules and operational changes caused by the severe weather.

The South-Link Line connects southern and eastern Taiwan, while the Taitung Line serves the eastern rail corridor. Rail authorities suspended reserved train services along both lines on Monday morning to ensure transport safety during the heavy rainstorm.
